correctness.rationale: The conditional-coordinate second-moment affine recurrence gives exact invariant variances and sharp coordinate factors; contraction supplies a unique invariant law. value.rationale: The natural one-noisy-derivative-per-step method poses a joint stationary-noise versus sharp rate design problem. A unique globally optimal design reduces all high-dimensional nonlinear choices to one monotone scalar equation and reveals a nontrivial crossover from square-root noise weights to squared noise weights at the fastest-rate boundary. A two-coordinate example reduces the exact stationary objective by approximately 20% against uniform sampling for the same rate. Scope is deliberately restricted to diagonal quadratics and independent additive noise.
